class.name: com.simplysoftware.ImageConverter.ImageConverter
class.event: Complete (Success As Boolean, SourcePath As String, TargetPath As String, Message As String)
FolderComplete (Success As Boolean, Count As Int, Message As String)
Progress (Percent As Int, CurrentFile As String)

method.name: ConvertImage
method.comment: Converts an image file on a background thread. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the original image. targetPath specifies the absolute path for the converted image. formatName specifies the target format extension. newWidth specifies the target width in pixels (use 0 to keep original). newHeight specifies the target height in pixels (use 0 to keep original). keepProportions specifies whether to lock the aspect ratio during resize. imageQuality specifies the output compression quality from 0 to 100 for JPG.

method.name: Stop
method.comment: Signals any active conversion or folder batch operation to stop immediately.

method.name: GetWidth
method.comment: Reads an image file and returns its width. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the image file.

method.name: ConvertImageBuffered
method.comment: Converts a BufferedImage to a different image type in memory. sourceImage specifies the original BufferedImage. imageType specifies the target integer image type.

method.name: IsInitialized
method.comment: Returns true if the object has been initialized.

method.name: SaveImage
method.comment: Saves a BufferedImage directly to a file on disk. img specifies the source BufferedImage object. targetPath specifies the absolute path for the saved image. formatName specifies the target format extension.

method.name: Initialize
method.comment: Initialises the converter object. EventName specifies the event name prefix for callbacks.

method.name: SupportedFormats
method.comment: Returns an array of all supported format names available for reading.

method.name: GetImageInfo
method.comment: Retrieves a quick summary of the image format and dimensions. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the image file.

method.name: CropImage
method.comment: Crops a rectangular region from an image and saves it to a new file. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the original image. targetPath specifies the absolute path for the cropped image. x specifies the starting X coordinate. y specifies the starting Y coordinate. width specifies the crop region width. height specifies the crop region height. formatName specifies the target format extension.

method.name: SupportedWriterFormats
method.comment: Returns an array of all supported format names available for writing.

method.name: ConvertImageToBytes
method.comment: Reads an image and exports it directly to a byte array in the requested format. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the image file. formatName specifies the target format extension.

method.name: ScaleImage
method.comment: Scales an image based on a multiplication factor and saves it to a new file. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the original image. targetPath specifies the absolute path for the scaled image. scaleFactor specifies the multiplier for dimensions. formatName specifies the target format extension.

method.name: GetFormat
method.comment: Probes an image file to detect its actual format name. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the image file.

method.name: HasWriter
method.comment: Checks if a writer plugin is available for a given format. formatName specifies the image format extension to check.

method.name: ConvertImageToBufferedImage
method.comment: Converts a raw byte array of image data into a BufferedImage. imageData specifies the raw image byte array.

method.name: ConvertFolder
method.comment: Scans a directory and asynchronously converts all valid images into the target format on a background thread. sourceDir specifies the absolute path of the source directory. targetDir specifies the absolute path of the destination directory. formatName specifies the target format extension for all files. newWidth specifies the target width in pixels (use 0 to keep original). newHeight specifies the target height in pixels (use 0 to keep original). keepProportions specifies whether to lock the aspect ratio during resize. imageQuality specifies the output compression quality from 0 to 100 for JPG.

method.name: ConvertBytesToImage
method.comment: Decodes a byte array into an image and saves it to a file. data specifies the raw image byte array. targetPath specifies the absolute path for the saved image. formatName specifies the target format extension.

method.name: RotateImage
method.comment: Rotates an image by a set number of degrees and saves it to a new file. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the original image. targetPath specifies the absolute path for the rotated image. degrees specifies the rotation angle. formatName specifies the target format extension.

method.name: GetMetadata
method.comment: Extracts available EXIF, IPTC, and XMP metadata from an image file on a background thread. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the image file.

method.name: HasReader
method.comment: Checks if a reader plugin is available for a given format. formatName specifies the image format extension to check.

method.name: ConvertImageStream
method.comment: Reads an image from an input stream and writes it to an output stream in the requested format. inputStream specifies the source data stream. outputStream specifies the target data stream. formatName specifies the target format extension.

method.name: LoadImage
method.comment: Loads an image from a file path directly into a BufferedImage. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the image file.

method.name: ResizeImage
method.comment: Resizes an image to explicit pixel dimensions and saves it to a new file. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the original image. targetPath specifies the absolute path for the resized image. newWidth specifies the target width in pixels. newHeight specifies the target height in pixels. formatName specifies the target format extension. keepProportions specifies whether to lock the aspect ratio during resize. imageQuality specifies the output compression quality from 0 to 100 for JPG.

method.name: ConvertBufferedImageToBytes
method.comment: Converts a BufferedImage into a raw byte array using the specified format. img specifies the source BufferedImage object. formatName specifies the target format extension.

method.name: GetHeight
method.comment: Reads an image file and returns its height. sourcePath specifies the absolute path of the image file.

property.name: LastError
property.comment: Retrieves the last error message that occurred during an operation.

field.name: UseCompression
field.comment: Determines whether output compression is enabled. Default is false. When true, explicit compression is applied only to JPG, JPEG, TIF, TIFF, and BigTIFF formats.
